test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Ever since young, we were taught that we __can__ obey our elders.
solution:
The correct answer is "**should.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence states that we were taught we "can" obey our elders, implying that it is optional.
 
 
• "Can" is used to express possibilities, which doesn't fit the context of the given sentence.
 
 
 
• However,** using "should" instead indicates that obeying our elders is expected or recommended.**
 
 
• **"Should" is used to say that something is the proper or best thing to do**, or to say that someone ought to do something or must do something.
 
 
• Example: We should exercise daily.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "cannot," means the opposite of the intended meaning.
 
• Option 3, "may," implies permission rather than expectation or recommendation.
 
• Option 4, "need not," implies that obeying our elders is not necessary.
